# FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790 / SP 800-57 vocabulary: split knowledge and dual control: clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: a CMVP testing laboratory and NIST, for a cryptographic module; nobody, for a vocabulary mapping decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).

Source: FIPS 140-3; ISO/IEC 19790; NIST SP 800-57 — not fetched (blocked); requirement text is our paraphrase and every clause marked † is unverified: csrc.nist.gov was unreachable when this map was written; term definitions are our paraphrase and are unverified

A vocabulary row says which SecuraCV mechanism a reader of FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790 language should look at. It is not a statement about module validation: SecuraCV has no validated cryptographic module and no FIPS level (row `validated-module`).
